name: Breakfast Creek Hotel
reason: Historic 1889 hotel/pub that Brisbane guides treat as a landmark, but only Wikipedia (not counted) names it here; Wikivoyage Brisbane page does not list it. Plausible draw as a heritage pub, but a venue that is mainly a pub/restaurant.
objection: Fails rule 2 if it is just a restaurant/bar; no counted visitor source found in one try, so cannot confirm it is a see/do stop.

name: Bribie Island Gondola Cruise
reason: Operator/vehicle, not a place (COVERAGE: a spot is a place); the place is Pumicestone Passage / Bribie Island.
objection: Visit Brisbane names it as a thing to do, but the destination layer should hold Bribie Island, not the cruise.

name: Brisbane Festival
reason: Annual festival held end of September; rule 4 (not there whenever you arrive).

reason: Hospital/heritage register entry only, no visitor source, no public visit (rule 1, 2).

name: Brisbane International Cruise Terminal

objection: A gateway for cruise visitors, but gateways with nothing to do on site are not spots.
